posts.cooked:
Dear Support,

I am writing to seek clarification regarding the evaluation of my submissions in BPT-1 and OPPE-1 for the subject System Commands.

  • In BPT-1, I had passed all the test cases, yet my score reflected only 75 marks. I have attached the result of synchro status below.

  • In OPPE-1, I successfully solved 4 out of 5 problems. However, the problem OPPE-1.4 was widely discussed as having an error, and all students faced the same issue. There was even a broadcast message acknowledging that some questions might show as wrong even if the solution was correct.

This makes the concept of synchro eval questionable. Without proper test cases and test runs being made available, it becomes very difficult to ensure that our code is evaluated fairly and accurately.

I kindly request you to review my submissions and provide clarification on the scoring. I would also appreciate it if the evaluation system could be reconsidered for fairness, especially in cases where the issue is with the test cases themselves.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,
Angeline

posts.cooked:
Angel2:
  • There was even a broadcast message acknowledging that some questions might show as wrong even if the solution was correct.
  • The broadcast message was in general, not targetted to any question.
  • The message clearly stated that if you have a SUBMISSION issue, you can ignore that; since we will resubmit your code on private test cases later. However if your code is inherently wrong and does not work on private test cases, then it will not fetch you any marks.

You have successfully solved 4 out of 5 questions, and recieved 80 marks for that. The fourth question was not solved.
ok sir, then how about my BPT-1 ?

posts.cooked:
Dear Student,

BPT1 was released on 23rd May 2025, with a deadline of 30th May 2025. You were expected to complete all questions within this timeframe. However, according to your Synchro status, none of the questions were solved within the deadline.

Despite this, we considered your submission on 3rd June 2025, which is why you were awarded 75 marks. If you wish, we can update your BPT1 score to 0 to reflect the missed deadline.
